channel.title: NBC Sports Fantasy Football News
channel.description: Latest player news and analysis for fantasy football from NBC Sports.

item.title: Seahawks S Nick Emmanwori (ankle) is inactive for Week 1 against the Patriots.
item.description: Emmanwori underwent surgery to deal with an ankle issue back in July. Despite some limited practice participation, the 22-year-old is not yet ready to return. With S Ty Okada (hamstring) also out, the Seahawks will lack depth in the back of the secondary for Week 1 against the Patriots.-Aditya Fuldeore

item.title: Seahawks WR Tory Horton (hamstring) is inactive for Week 1 against the Patriots.
item.description: Horton got in some limited practices earlier this week as he deals with a hamstring injury. He will miss opening week against the Patriots, boosting Rashid Shaheed for some deep targets in Week 1. Also inactive for the Seahawks are S Nick Emmanwori, G Beau Stephens, QB Jalen Milroe, TE Nick Kallerup, S Ty Okada, and DE Mike Morris. Milroe will serve as the emergency third quarterback.-Aditya Fuldeore

item.title: Patriots RB TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) is inactive for Week 1 against the Seahawks.
item.description: Henderson was ruled out with an ankle injury after not practicing all week. Rhamondre Stevenson will be the workhorse running back for New England, propelling him into the fantasy RB2 conversation. Also inactive for the Patriots are CB Karon Prunty, LB Erick Hunter, OT Walter Rouse, C Ben Brown, WR Efton Chism, and QB Behren Morton.-Aditya Fuldeore

item.title: 49ers TE George Kittle (Achilles) was limited in Wednesday’s practice.
item.description: Kittle gets in another limited practice ahead of the 49ers’ Week 1 Australia game against the Rams. We expect him to continue to get limited practices in beyond this week as the 32-year-old nurses his Achilles. Also limited was FB Kyle Juszczyk (finger). Both are still in line to play this week.-Aditya Fuldeore

item.title: Eagles TE Eli Stowers (hamstring) was limited in Wednesday’s practice.
item.description: Stowers has been dealing with a hamstring injury he suffered in the preseason and he opens Week 1 with a limited practice. The 23-year-old rookie was already in line for a limited role this season after a subpar training camp but now may be limited even further with a soft tissue injury. Stowers is off fantasy radars in redraft leagues but his absence propels Dallas Goedert into borderline top-10 tight end territory.-Aditya Fuldeore

item.title: Bears QB Tyson Bagent (back) did not participate in Wednesday’s practice.
item.description: Bagent popped up on the injury report with a back issue to open the week. He previously dealt with a hamstring issue but this appears to be a new injury. It’s unclear if the back will keep Bagent out of Week 1 just yet, but Case Keenum will step up at backup quarterback if he misses time.-Aditya Fuldeore

item.title: Keaton Mitchell (hamstring) was limited in Wednesday’s practice.
item.description: Mitchell went down with the hamstring injury late in camp but returned to practice earlier this week. The team will likely keep his workload light in practice and on Sunday. Omarion Hampton remains the clear lead back in LA, with Mitchell mixing in for some designed touches. He will be an RB4 for his first game as a Charger.-Kyle Dvorchak

item.title: Chargers WR Brenen Thompson (hip) was limited on Wednesday.
item.description: Thompson tweaked his hip in preseason play back on August 20th. A limited session on Wednesday puts him on track to play in Week 1 against the Cardinals, potentially as the team’s WR4 and a special teams contributor.-Nic Bodiford

item.title: Tucker Kraft (knee) is not on the injury report ahead of his Week 1 game against the Vikings.
item.description: Kraft has been trending toward playing in Week 1 for a long time. Not appearing on the injury report in any capacity means he is good to go. Kraft may still have somewhat of a pitch count for his first game back from a 2025 torn ACL, but Matt LaFleur will be sure to get him the ball when he is on the field. Kraft is a fantasy TE1 for the Packers’ Week 1 game against Minnesota.-Kyle Dvorchak

item.title: Commanders RB Rachaad White (hamstring) is practicing in full for Week 1 against the Eagles.
item.description: White’s hamstring strain is officially behind him. The veteran running back is expected to assume passing down duties with his new team, though starting RB Jacory Croskey-Merritt (groin) has reportedly been improving his receiving skills this summer. If Croskey-Merritt can play this weekend, White will only be a mild FLEX play in PPR formats.-Nic Bodiford
